newsitem.title: USA: ALRENCO IN $30 MILLION CREDIT FACILITY.
newsitem.headline: ALRENCO IN $30 MILLION CREDIT FACILITY.

text.p: Alrenco Inc said Thursday it has signed an agreement for a new $30 million credit facility with Bank One Kentucky, N.A.
The term of the credit facility is three years, and replaces a smaller, more costly facility from another bank, the rental-purchase store operator said.

"Bank One's ability to offer us a much lower interest rate with increased funding for our expansion plans affords Alrenco a much greater opportunity to capitalize on the consolidation taking place in the rental-purchase industry," Theodore Wilson, Alrenco's chief financial officer, said in a news release.
Alrenco shares were unchanged at 15 Thursday.
